statement_en: Let \(a>0\), \(b\in \mathbb{R}\), and \(a>|b|\). Compute the parameter-dependent integral \[I(a,b):=\int_0^{\infty}e^{-ax}J_0(bx)\,dx,\] where \(J_0(z)\) is the Bessel function of the first kind of order zero.
final_code:
import Mathlib

noncomputable def I (J0 : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x in Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-a * x) * J0 (b * x) ∂MeasureTheory.volume

theorem besselJ0_parameter_dependent_integral
    (J0 : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : |b| < a) :
    I J0 a b = 1 / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
  sorry
